fusions.name: Scrap Scramble
fusions.desc: Pecks at everything within 2 tiles for 3 damage, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Second Helping
fusions.desc: Gorges on a target at or below 25% health for 20 damage, using up your afflictions on it and adding their remaining damage to the blow. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Scattered Grain
fusions.desc: Scatters a feeding ground 4 tiles across at your feet. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and every ally inside it.

fusions.name: Picked Clean
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
